title: Dont Touch Floor PLugin
description: This is plugin that kills a player if they touch ground(naturally generated block)
body:
About
This is a Minecraft plugin code that kills player if they touch floor(Naturally generated blocks). It is inspired by **Dream Team Challange** of **@georgenotfound** channel *
```
https://youtu.be/17HqO9O_w54?si=p6pLwczqkeGL9cNc
```
*. You can also download get source code from 
```
https://github.com/Asmin8/Dont-Touch-Floor-MC-Plugin
``` 
where you get new features and bug fixes first and can modify as you want. 


This is a small effort from AG studios so pls support us.
